cohort: 360 somatically healthy women experiencing their first physiological pregnancy, divided into two age groups (22-28 years and 36-42 years).
finding: Older women had a statistically significant increase in the incidence of gestational diabetes mellitus, pre-eclampsia, fetoplacental insufficiency, a higher need for medical support, increased Cesarean delivery rates, and lower newborn Apgar scores compared to younger women.
mod_finding: Older women had significantly higher Cesarean delivery rates compared to younger women (44.4% vs. 22.8%).
